Corporate credit risk & environmental tax reform

Independent research · First-author manuscript

Constructed a KMV-based expected default frequency measure and evaluated the 2018 environmental fee-to-tax reform using firm-level panel data. Extended the study from DID to DDD and examined restructuring and market-clearing mechanisms.

Research methods

KMV–EDF · DID/DDD · DDML · Stata

My contribution

  • Framed the research question, constructed risk measures and prepared firm-panel data.
  • Implemented fixed-effects models, parallel-trend and placebo tests, endogeneity and robustness checks, and mechanism analysis.
  • Extended the design to DDD and DDML and developed the manuscript and research figures.

Output

Outstanding Undergraduate Thesis · 96/100 · School rank 1st

For the complete study, please request the manuscript and supplementary research materials by email.

Zhanjiang has strong coastal tourism and fishery resources, yet consumer-oriented research on its recreational-fisheries sector remained limited. Our goal was to understand what actually drives visitor satisfaction, identify the most urgent experience gaps, and convert the findings into practical recommendations for operators, industry organizations and policymakers.

What matters most to recreational-fishery visitors — and where should the industry improve first?

03

Analytical Integration

Integrated questionnaire analysis, online-review text analytics and statistical modeling into one coherent consumer-insight framework.

04

Insight & Delivery

Synthesized findings into strategic recommendations and led the production of the final research report and competition presentation.

climate:
Global temperature forecasting with LSTM & ARIMA

First-listed co-first author

Modelled global temperature dynamics from 1880–2022, integrating neural and statistical time-series approaches with environmental interpretation.

Research methods

Python · LSTM · ARIMA · Correlation analysis

My contribution

  • Implemented forecasting software and analysed 1880–2022 global temperature data using LSTM and ARIMA within the co-authored study.
  • Used Pearson and Spearman correlations to examine associations between greenhouse gases and temperature, including pandemic-period patterns. These analyses do not isolate a causal pandemic effect.
  • Connected the quantitative results with environmental-management questions and contributed original drafting and revision, keeping model projections distinct from observed changes.

Output

Peer-reviewed publication · First Prize, Asia–Pacific MCM

The published author-contribution statement credits TAN Can with data curation, formal analysis, investigation, resources, software, original drafting and revision. Methodology is credited to Junyi Zhong.

The emissions and pandemic analyses are associational; forecasting and correlation do not establish causal effects.

CASE 01 / AVIATION SAFETY

Aviation Safety Risk & Flight-Technique Evaluation

2023 MathorCup Mathematical Modeling Challenge · Second Prize

Turning high-frequency flight data into interpretable safety signals, pilot-operation evaluation and automated warning logic.

The Question

How can QAR flight data be transformed into a practical framework for identifying key safety variables, quantifying unstable flight-control behavior and evaluating flight technique?

The project required working across heterogeneous flight parameters, outlier-prone measurements and multiple analytical objectives—from identifying safety-critical variables to evaluating pilot-operation patterns and designing a real-time warning mechanism.

Team competition study · research writing and analytical interpretation.

MY ROLE

Research Writing & Analysis Lead

Data & Analysis

Collected and preprocessed relevant flight data, supported empirical analysis and worked with the modeling member to interpret model outputs.

Research Integration

Connected assumptions, analytical procedures, figures and results into a coherent technical narrative across the project’s five modeling tasks.

Final Delivery

Led manuscript development, formatting, revision and final report integration, producing a technical submission including code.

Technical report · Full report available on reasonable request

Consumer Review Intelligence with BERT–BiLSTM–CNN

TRACK 01 / NEURAL DYNAMICS

Inside ACGND

How can high-dimensional, time-varying tensor inversion be solved quickly enough for dynamic AI and engineering systems?

Dynamic Tensor Inversion is relevant to tensor-based AI frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch. Conventional numerical methods can incur lagging errors in dynamic settings; neural-dynamics approaches address this challenge, with different trade-offs in accuracy and computational cost.

O(n³)O(n²)

The research asks how an evolving tensor can be inverted while keeping pace with a dynamic system.

2022RESEARCH FOUNDATION

Mapping the Evolution of Research on China’s Marine Intangible Cultural Heritage

FIRST AUTHOR

MANUSCRIPT IN REVISION · PREPARING FOR RESUBMISSION

Prior Review History: External peer review at Cultural Heritage (CSSCI)

My first systematic research project, built around intensive literature reading, bibliometric mapping and academic synthesis. The work examined two decades of Chinese research on marine intangible cultural heritage and established the literature-review and research-writing foundation that later supported my empirical work.

1,000+Papers reviewed
2003–2022Research window
3Major Chinese databases

CiteSpace · Bibliometric Analysis · Knowledge Mapping · NoteExpress

ABSTRACT PREVIEW

Using literature from CNKI, Wanfang and VIP covering 2003–2022, this study maps the evolution of China’s marine intangible-cultural-heritage research through bibliometric and qualitative analysis. It identifies the field’s major research clusters around preservation, inheritance and individual heritage cases, while highlighting emerging themes including rural revitalisation, living heritage transmission and digital preservation.

Bibliometric mapping of research clusters and emerging themes in China’s marine intangible cultural heritage literature, 2003–2022.

My first systematic research project, built around intensive literature reading, bibliometric mapping and academic synthesis. The work examined two decades of Chinese research on marine intangible cultural heritage and established the literature-review and research-writing foundation that later supported my empirical work.

1,000+Papers reviewed
2003–2022Research window

Using literature from CNKI, Wanfang and VIP covering 2003–2022, this study maps the evolution of China’s marine intangible-cultural-heritage research through bibliometric and qualitative analysis. It identifies the field’s major research clusters around preservation, inheritance and individual heritage cases, while highlighting emerging themes including rural revitalisation, living heritage transmission and digital preservation.

CASE 01 / AVIATION SAFETY

Aviation Safety Risk & Flight-Technique Evaluation

2023 MathorCup Mathematical Modeling Challenge · Second Prize

Turning high-frequency flight data into interpretable safety signals, pilot-operation evaluation and automated warning logic.

The Question

How can QAR flight data be transformed into a practical framework for identifying key safety variables, quantifying unstable flight-control behavior and evaluating flight technique?

The project required working across heterogeneous flight parameters, outlier-prone measurements and multiple analytical objectives—from identifying safety-critical variables to evaluating pilot-operation patterns and designing a real-time warning mechanism.

Team competition study · research writing and analytical interpretation.

MY ROLE

Research Writing & Analysis Lead

Data & Analysis

Collected and preprocessed relevant flight data, supported empirical analysis and worked with the modeling member to interpret model outputs.

Research Integration

Connected assumptions, analytical procedures, figures and results into a coherent technical narrative across the project’s five modeling tasks.

Final Delivery

Led manuscript development, formatting, revision and final report integration, producing a technical submission including code.

Technical report · Full report available on reasonable request

Multi-Indicator Social-System Early Warning

The project required turning heterogeneous country-level indicators into one structured analytical system, balancing indicator weighting, variable selection, early-warning logic and temporal prediction.

CASE 04 / CONSUMER NLP

Consumer Review Intelligence with BERT–BiLSTM–CNN

2023 IMMCHE · Consumer-review mathematical modeling study

Moving from raw consumer text to product classification, sentiment signals, keyword interpretation and human–machine review detection.

The Question

How can unstructured review text be transformed into reliable signals about product categories, consumer sentiment, ratings and review authenticity?

The project treated consumer reviews as a multi-task NLP problem rather than a single sentiment-classification exercise. The workflow combined text preprocessing, semantic classification, keyword extraction, rating-related analysis and human–machine review discrimination.
